input: Reminder logged: quarterly gearbox lubrication due next week. No current issues on the line.

input: Ethernet to the arm drops every time it passes the weld station — suspect the cable in the drag chain is damaged.
expected_summary: Robot arm's Ethernet connection drops at a specific position, suspected drag-chain cable damage.
notes: Root cause is likely physical cable wear, but the reported symptom is the comms drop — labeled communication_error per the primary-symptom rule. mechanical_fault is a defensible alternative; good discussion case.

input: Load cell LC-12 drifting about +0.8 kg per hour, zero offset now at 14.3 kg after tare.
